entities.summary: The Stade du 4-août or 4 August Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso. It is currently used mostly for football matches and it has an athletics track. The stadium has a capacity of 29,800 people. Étoile Filante de Ouagadougou play their home games at the stadium.
